name: framestudio
description: Local-first studio for AI images and video: your machine, your models, your keys.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ui build && bun run --cwd desktop build
scripts.api:gen: uv run --directory backend framestudio openapi --out ../ui/src/api/openapi.json && bun run --cwd ui api:types
scripts.lint: bun run lint:py && bun run lint:ts
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --directory backend ruff format . && prettier --write .
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd ui typecheck && bun run --cwd desktop typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:py && bun run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: bun run --cwd ui test && bun run --cwd desktop test
